subject: Checking timeline — did you receive the Sizing & Pricing deck?
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@novablue.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sizing & pricing deck + next-step options

Hi Samira — great to meet earlier. Thanks for walking through Novablue’s main production constraints and target latency goals. As promised, attaching the Sizing & Pricing deck that maps our recommended Dedicated and Hosted configurations to monthly unit costs. I also included a one-page estimate (editable) so procurement can extract line items.

High level next steps I proposed on the call:
- Confirm priority/timeline for a pilot (2–4 week PoC)
- Decide whether you want Dedicated capacity (SLA) or Hosted to start
- Schedule a 20–30 minute walkthrough of the deck for technical stakeholders

Suggested times (PST): Wed 6/2 10:00–10:30, Thu 6/3 14:00–14:30, or Mon 6/7 09:30–10:00. If those don’t work, send a couple slots that do.

Attachments: [Novablue-sizing-deck-v2.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB)], [redwood-estimate-NB-0167.xlsx (Excel, 55KB)]

Thanks — happy to jump on a short screen share to walk the numbers and the VPC/private deployment options.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.com
From: Samira Khan <samira@novablue.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novablue.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 14:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Sizing & pricing deck + next-step options

Thanks Kimberly — I received the deck and have circulated it to my CTO and procurement. Quick question for the tech team: does your Dedicated option support VPC peering and private Egress so we can keep model traffic inside our VPC? Procurement also asked whether you have a template for standard security controls (SSO/SAML, audit logs, retention).

We’re still evaluating priority but aiming to decide before the end of Q3. I’ll try to get preliminary feedback by next week. If procurement needs an editable copy of the estimate, cc’d email is the right place.

—Samira
Director of Platform Engineering | Novablue
samira@novablue.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@novablue.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 10:03:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Sizing & pricing deck + next-step options

Hi Samira — checking in quickly since I haven’t seen any procurement feedback yet. Are you still planning to prioritize this for Q3? If priorities have shifted, totally understand — a quick note helps us set expectations on our side.

If it’s helpful, I can run a 20-minute walkthrough tailored to procurement and your cloud/security team to call out the Dedicated VPC peer options, KMS/HSM support, and where audit-logging shows up in the estimate. Dev (cc’d) is our SE who can answer the VPC/ops questions live.

Suggested walkthrough slots (PST): Tue 6/8 11:00–11:20, Tue 6/8 15:00–15:20, Wed 6/9 09:00–09:20. If none work, send a handful of times that do and we’ll make it happen.

Also, procurement: the attached estimate is editable; happy to provide a line-item CSV if that speeds things up.

Attachment: [redwood-estimate-NB-0167.xlsx (editable)]

Best,
Kimberly
From: procurement@novablue.com
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@novablue.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 11:03:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Sizing & pricing deck + next-step options

Apologies for the slow reply — we were collecting cost approvals across two business units. We did receive the deck and estimate. Procurement has two asks before we can move to an internal approval: a downloadable line-item CSV and a short (20 minute) walkthrough for finance/procurement focused on billing cadence, discounts for committed capacity, and cancellation terms.

Can you confirm availability Tue 6/8 15:00 or Wed 6/9 09:00 PST? If you can’t make those times, please propose two alternatives. Also please include the SLA language for Dedicated in the walkthrough packet.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
Novablue
